_source.note: Policy statements copied verbatim. aad.md: every statement. exo.md: only statements a control maps to or may map to. Re-check when ScubaGear publishes new baseline versions (IDs carry a version suffix).

statements.MS.AAD.2.1v1: Users detected as high risk SHALL be blocked.
statements.MS.AAD.2.2v1: A notification SHOULD be sent to the administrator when high-risk users are detected.
statements.MS.AAD.2.3v1: Sign-ins detected as high-risk SHALL be blocked.
statements.MS.AAD.3.1v1: Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be enforced for all users.
statements.MS.AAD.3.2v2: MFA SHALL be enforced for all users.
statements.MS.AAD.3.3v2: If Microsoft Authenticator is enabled, it SHALL be configured to show login context information.
statements.MS.AAD.3.4v1: The "Authentication methods manage migration" feature SHALL be set to "Migration complete."
statements.MS.AAD.3.5v2: The authentication methods of short message service (SMS), voice call, and email one-time passcode (OTP) SHALL be disabled.
statements.MS.AAD.3.6v1: Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be required for highly privileged roles.
statements.MS.AAD.3.7v1: Managed devices SHOULD be required for authentication.
statements.MS.AAD.3.8v1: Managed devices SHOULD be required to register MFA.
statements.MS.AAD.3.9v1: Device code authentication SHOULD be blocked.
statements.MS.AAD.4.1v1: Security logs SHALL be sent to the agency's security operations center for monitoring.
statements.MS.AAD.5.1v1: Only administrators SHALL be allowed to register applications.
statements.MS.AAD.5.2v1: User consent to applications SHALL be restricted.
statements.MS.AAD.5.3v1: An administrative consent workflow SHALL be configured for applications.
statements.MS.AAD.5.5v1: Application password addition SHOULD be blocked.
statements.MS.AAD.5.6v1: Application password lifetime SHOULD be restricted to 180 days or less.
statements.MS.AAD.5.7v1: Application certificate lifetime SHOULD be restricted to 365 days or less.
statements.MS.AAD.7.1v1: A minimum of two users and a maximum of eight users SHALL be provisioned with the Global Administrator role.
statements.MS.AAD.7.2v1: Privileged users SHALL be provisioned with finer-grained roles instead of the Global Administrator role.
statements.MS.AAD.7.3v1: Privileged users SHALL be provisioned cloud-only accounts separate from an on-premises directory or other federated identity providers.
statements.MS.AAD.7.4v1: Permanent active role assignments SHALL NOT be allowed for highly privileged roles.
statements.MS.AAD.7.5v1: Provisioning users to highly privileged roles SHALL NOT occur outside of a PAM system.
statements.MS.AAD.7.6v1: Activation of the Global Administrator role SHALL require approval.
statements.MS.AAD.7.7v1: Eligible and active highly privileged role assignments SHALL trigger an alert.
statements.MS.AAD.7.8v1: User activation of the Global Administrator role SHALL trigger an alert.
statements.MS.AAD.7.9v1: User activation of other highly privileged roles SHOULD trigger an alert.
statements.MS.AAD.8.1v1: Guest users SHOULD have limited or restricted access to Microsoft Entra ID directory objects.
statements.MS.AAD.8.2v1: Only users with the "Guest Inviter" role SHOULD be able to invite guest users.
statements.MS.AAD.8.3v1: Guest invites SHOULD only be allowed to be sent to specific external domains that have been authorized by the agency for legitimate business purposes.
statements.MS.AAD.9.1v1: Risky AI agents SHALL be blocked.
statements.MS.EXO.1.1v2: Automatic forwarding to external domains SHALL be disabled.
